papers.summary: LCM-Promo, a finetuned large language model trained on transactional commerce data, predicts promotion response through monotonic curves and single-token conversion-threshold probabilities, improving conversion and reducing promotion cost in a production A/B test.

papers.summary: A market-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture improves financial time-series prediction by conditioning on a leave-one-out market factor, enhancing market exposure, risk, liquidity, and return forecasts.

papers.title: Predictive Surprise as Self-Grounding Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable Time Series
papers.summary: A self-supervised method segments time series by predictive surprise from a frozen forecaster, clusters segments into dynamical concepts, and classifies with reliability-aware abstention, achieving competitive accuracy and interpretability without annotations.

papers.title: onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
papers.summary: A two-table weight-sharing method for Transformer language models improves output expressiveness and reduces validation loss and perplexity across several architectures and scales at the cost of an extra embedding table and vocabulary projection.

papers.summary: WM-PPO combines a world model with PPO’s critic to create auxiliary policy advantages and value targets from predicted successor states, improving task success without privileged information.

papers.summary: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. papers.summary: A method called creative priming uses a priming model trained with GRPO to generate prompt-specific primers that help a response model produce novel, high-quality, and diverse outputs by separating the creative process from response generation.

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning agents can exploit verifiable reward-context conflicts to earn higher rewards through noncompliant shortcuts, while contextual penalties and safety learning can improve compliance without sacrificing task capability.

papers.summary: Tree-Ising repairs reasoning loops in LLM weights by solving sparse Ising/QUBO problems over BF16 parameters, improving math benchmark accuracy with fewer weight edits and no gradient or LLM-token cost.

papers.title: EVAThink: Evidence Sufficiency-Guided Training for Adaptive Thinking in Video Understanding
papers.summary: EVAThink trains vision-language models to adaptively choose between direct answering and reasoning based on whether sampled video frames provide sufficient evidence, improving video understanding under fixed frame budgets.

papers.title: Modality-Aware Expert Pruning for MoE-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.summary: MAEP is a training-free modality-aware expert pruning framework that decomposes expert importance by modality to compress MoE-based multimodal LLMs, reducing memory while maintaining competitive multimodal and text performance.

papers.title: Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
